name: Whisper STT
description: Speech-to-text via OpenAI Whisper. Two paths: (1) server-side OpenAI Whisper API as a fallback STT provider when no Deepgram key is set, (2) browser-side local Whisper running whisper-tiny.en via Transformers.js in a Web Worker (WebGPU → WASM fallback). Loads dynamically into graph-viewer.html when installed; uninstalling removes both paths and disables the openai option from the STT provider dropdown.
